name: Limbic Encephalitis Psychiatric Variant
aliases: Autoimmune Limbic Encephalitis with Psychiatric Presentation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Graus et al. 2016 Autoimmune Encephalitis Criteria

criteria.description: Subacute onset (less than 3 months) of working memory deficits, seizures, or psychiatric symptoms
MRI showing bilateral abnormalities in medial temporal lobes
Detection of specific neuronal autoantibodies in serum or CSF (e.g., anti-Hu, anti-Ma2, anti-NMDAR)
CSF pleocytosis or elevated protein indicating inflammation
Exclusion of alternative causes such as infections, metabolic, or neoplastic etiologies

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Subacute onset of limbic symptoms plus MRI abnormalities in medial temporal lobes and exclusion of alternative diagnoses
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Autoantibody testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical and imaging criteria are met.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Psychiatric disturbances including mood disorder and psychosis

common.symptomName: Autonomic dysfunction (e.g., tachycardia, blood pressure variability)

laboratory: Presence of neuronal autoantibodies (e.g., anti-Hu, anti-Ma2, anti-NMDAR)
Elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) may be absent or mild
imaging: MRI brain showing hyperintensities in bilateral medial temporal lobes on T2/FLAIR sequences
FDG-PET may show hypermetabolism in limbic regions
other: EEG showing temporal lobe epileptiform discharges or slowing
Detection of underlying neoplasm in paraneoplastic cases (e.g., small cell lung carcinoma, testicular tumors)

distinguishingFeatures: CSF PCR positive for HSV DNA
More prominent necrotizing inflammation on imaging

redFlags: New onset seizures in adult with psychiatric symptoms
MRI showing bilateral medial temporal lobe abnormalities
references: Graus F, et al. A clinical approach to diagnosis of autoimmune encephalitis. Lancet Neurol. 2016 Apr;15(4):391-404.
Dalmau J, et al. Autoimmune encephalitis: clinical spectrum and diagnostic criteria. Neurology. 2017.
Lancaster E. The diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune encephalitis. J Clin Neurol. 2016.
